description: Fetch a saved site/intent: plain HTTP when the recipe holds, a browser when it does not. Use items only when ok is true; on an error, report it rather than guessing.

heal.description: recompile the recipe on fallback (default true)

id.description: the entity id, when the saved URL carried one

page.description: the page number, when the saved URL carried one

query.description: the search term, when the saved URL carried one

name: fetch
